title: Grain boundary engineering using metallomesogen in formamidinium–caesium lead triiodide for stable perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells - Nature Energy
gist: Zhejiang University researchers show that sparse formamidinium doping in Cs(FA)PbI3 distorts grain boundaries and drives defects, and that a Pb-based metallomesogen spread along grain boundaries fixes this. Perovskite/silicon tandem cells using a 1.66-eV Cs(FA)PbI3 absorber reach 32.08% efficiency (31.62% certified), keeping 95% after ~3,000 h of MPP tracking and 93% after 1,500 h of 85/85 damp heat. Only the abstract and front matter are available; the full text is paywalled.

insights.claim: Formamidinium-doped caesium lead triiodide, Cs(FA)PbI3, is a promising front-cell absorber for perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells because of its good stability, but producing high-quality films of it remains difficult.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Inorganic-rich perovskite top cells are the stability-focused route to commercial tandems; film quality is the bottleneck.
insights.quote: promising front-cell absorber for tandem solar cells owing to its good stability, yet obtaining high-quality films remains a challenge

insights.claim: Sparse doping of oversized formamidinium cations into caesium lead triiodide causes severe grain-boundary distortion, which promotes defect formation and degrades solar-cell performance.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Identifies a specific degradation mechanism that process makers can target.
insights.quote: sparse doping of oversized FA cations induces severe grain boundary (GB) distortion

insights.claim: The researchers developed a lead-based metallomesogen that forms a mesophase with both solid-like and liquid-like properties, which lets it spread uniformly along grain boundaries in Cs(FA)PbI3 films.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Liquid-crystal-like additives are an emerging toolkit for passivating perovskite films.
insights.quote: forms a mesophase exhibiting both solid-like and liquid-like properties

insights.claim: Spreading the lead-based metallomesogen along grain boundaries reduces grain-boundary distortion, relieves shear strain, keeps the lattice intact and reduces defect formation in Cs(FA)PbI3 films.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: A strain-relief additive raises both efficiency and durability, the two factors that set tandem bankability.
insights.quote: alleviating GB distortion, relieving shear strain, preserving lattice integrity and mitigating defect formation

insights.claim: The best tandem devices pair the 1.66-eV Cs(FA)PbI3 absorber with a bromine-containing grain-boundary modifier.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: The 1.66-eV bandgap is set to match a silicon bottom cell.

insights.claim: Four inventors on the Zhejiang University team, including Yong Wang and Deren Yang, hold a provisional Chinese patent (CN. 202511252267.4) on the grain-boundary metallomesogen approach.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: The IP is held in China and could be licensed to Chinese tandem PV makers.

insights.claim: Perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells using the metallomesogen-treated Cs(FA)PbI3 top cell reached a champion efficiency of 32.08%, with 31.62% independently certified.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Above 32% puts this stability-oriented inorganic-rich chemistry in the same range as the best reported tandems.

insights.claim: The tandem cells kept 95% of their initial performance after about 3,000 hours of maximum power point tracking.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Operational stability over thousands of hours addresses the main objection to bankable perovskite PV.
insights.quote: retaining 95% of the initial performance after ~3,000 h under maximum power point tracking

insights.claim: The tandem cells kept 93% of their initial performance after 1,500 hours of damp-heat stress at 85% relative humidity and 85 °C.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Damp-heat survival is the key gate in the IEC-style reliability testing that module buyers require.
insights.quote: 93% after 1,500 h under 85% relative humidity and 85 °C damp-heat stressing

insights.claim: The work was carried out largely at Zhejiang University with Huaneng Clean Energy Research Institute, and was supported by Chinese national and regional science funds.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
entities: National Natural Science Foundation of China
insights.so_what: A Chinese state utility research institute's involvement points to a path toward Chinese industrial use of tandem PV.
